Guidance & outlook: India's vodka category has grown at over 20% CAGR between FY22 and FY26, significantly ahead of broader IMFL growth.
While vodka accounts for nearly 28% of the global spirits market, its share in the Indian IMFL industry has increased from 4.6% in Q1 FY26 to 6.1% in Q1 FY 27.
Looking ahead, we expect our P&A portfolio to deliver over 25% volume growth during FY 27, supported by a robust innovation pipeline, expanding distribution and favorable industry trends.
Growth & demand: Our performance was driven by the continued success of our premiumization strategy with our P&A portfolio delivering 36% volume growth during the quarter and significantly outpacing the industry.
During Q1 FY 27, we delivered a strong all -round performance with total IMFL volume of 10 million cases, reflecting 3% year -on-year growth.

When I launched Magic Moments vodka in 2006, that time , the vodka saliency was 1% and there were hundreds of vodkas launched, but Magic continued to become the market leader with 60% market share in two decades.
